flows:
Navigate to https://revoke.cash then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
On the revoke.cash address page for vitalik.eth, wait for the approvals list to finish loading.
Select a network from the network selector (for example Ethereum).
Open the 'Sort By' dropdown and choose 'Newest to Oldest'.
Then type a token name that appears in the list (for example 'USDC') into the search field above the approvals list.
Never press 'Revoke' or any button that edits, approves or moves funds.
Assert that the 'Sort By' control shows 'Newest to Oldest' and that the approvals list shows only rows whose visible token name matches the search text.

summary:
Opened the approvals page for vitalik.eth and waited for the approvals list to load.
Selected a network, changed the approval-list sorting to “Newest to Oldest,” and entered a token search in the list.
The list was filtered so that all visible approval rows matched the search text, and the selected sort order remained “Newest to Oldest.”
No wallet was connected and no approval or fund-changing action was taken.
one_liner: filtered and sorted approvals on revoke.cash

approvals_list_token_search_match.human_description: Checking visible approval rows against the search text
approvals_list_token_search_match.code_js: (() => { const term = el(12).querySelector('input[aria-label="Search by Spender"]')?.value.trim().toLowerCase(); if (term == null) return null; const rows = [...el(12).querySelectorAll('tr, [role="row"]')].filter(row => row.querySelector('td, [role="cell"]') && row.offsetParent !== null); return rows.every(row => row.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(term)); })()
